shared_elements: quadruped animal in profile with four legs and raised head
horizontal band of closely repeated short strokes/marks running across the surface
curved hook-like terminals resembling animal heads or beaks
isolated small figures placed above the main horizontal band
justification: The most specific correspondence is a broad horizontal register of tightly repeated short vertical strokes spanning the field, with a small profile quadruped and hook-headed curved forms placed above and beside it in both. The decisive difference is technique and idiom: A is low-relief sculpture on a shaped stone pillar with volumetric, modelled animals and a human figure, while B is a flat, uniformly thick red-painted silhouette drawing on a rock face with no modelling at all.
